### **Table 1.  NHANES Variables and Descriptions**

| **Variable** | **Description** |
|--------------|-----------------|
| **SurveyYr** | Survey cycle year. |
| **ID** | Participant identifier. |
| **Gender** | Sex of participant (male/female). |
| **Age** | Age in years; ages ≥80 coded as 80. |
| **AgeDecade** | Age grouped in 10-year intervals. |
| **AgeMonths** | Age in months for younger participants. |
| **Race1** | Race/ethnicity: Mexican, Hispanic, White, Black, Other. |
| **Race3** | Race including Asian category (not available in all years). |
| **Education** | Highest educational attainment. |
| **MaritalStatus** | Current marital status. |
| **HHIncome** | Annual household income categories. |
| **HHIncomeMid** | Midpoint of income category (numeric). |
| **Poverty** | Family income-to-poverty ratio. |
| **HomeRooms** | Number of rooms in the home. |
| **HomeOwn** | Housing tenure: own, rent, or other. |
| **Work** | Employment status  |
| **Weight** | Body weight (kg). |
| **Length** | Recumbent length (cm) for young children. |
| **HeadCirc** | Head circumference (cm). |
| **Height** | Standing height (cm). |
| **BMI** | Body mass index (kg/m²). |
| **BMICatUnder20yrs** | BMI category for ages 2–19. |
| **BMI_WHO** | BMI category based on WHO cutoffs. |
| **Pulse** | Pulse rate (beats per minute). |
| **BPSysAve** | Average systolic blood pressure. |
| **BPDiaAve** | Average diastolic blood pressure. |
| **BPSys1** | First systolic blood pressure reading. |
| **BPSys2** | Second systolic blood pressure reading. |
| **BPSys3** | Third systolic blood pressure reading. |
| **BPDia1** | First diastolic blood pressure reading. |
| **BPDia2** | Second diastolic blood pressure reading. |
| **BPDia3** | Third diastolic blood pressure reading. |
| **Testosterone** | Total testosterone level. |
| **DirectChol** | Direct HDL cholesterol (mmol/L). |
| **TotChol** | Total cholesterol (mmol/L). |
| **UrineVol1/2** | Urine volume from first/second test. |
| **UrineFlow1/2** | Urine flow rate (mL/min). |
| **Diabetes** | Self-reported doctor-diagnosed diabetes (Yes/No). |
| **DiabetesAge** | Age at first diabetes diagnosis. |
| **HealthGen** | Self-rated general health. |
| **DaysPhysHlthBad** | Days physical health was “not good” in past 30 days. |
| **DaysMentHlthBad** | Days mental health was “not good” in past 30 days. |
| **LittleInterest** | Lack of interest in activities (PHQ item). |
| **Depressed** | Feeling depressed or hopeless (PHQ item). |
| **nPregnancies** | Number of pregnancies (females only). |
| **nBabies** | Number of live births. |
| **PregnantNow** | Pregnancy status at exam. |
| **Age1stBaby** | Age at first live birth. |
| **SleepHrsNight** | Hours of sleep per night. |
| **SleepTrouble** | Ever told by a provider of sleep trouble (Yes/No). |
| **PhysActive** | Participation in moderate/vigorous activity (Yes/No). |
| **PhysActiveDays** | Days per week physically active. |
| **TVHrsDay** | Hours of TV watching per day. |
| **CompHrsDay** | Hours of computer/device use per day. |
| **TVHrsDayChild** | TV hours per day (children). |
| **CompHrsDayChild** | Computer use per day (children). |
| **Alcohol12PlusYr** | Consumed ≥12 alcoholic drinks in the past year (Yes/No). |
| **AlcoholDay** | Drinks consumed on drinking days. |
| **AlcoholYear** | Days drank alcohol in past year. |
| **SmokeNow** | Currently smokes (if smoked ≥100 lifetime cigarettes). |
| **Smoke100** | Smoked at least 100 cigarettes in lifetime (Yes/No). |
| **SmokeAge** | Age started smoking regularly. |
| **Marijuana** | Ever used marijuana. |
| **AgeFirstMarij** | Age first used marijuana. |
| **RegularMarij** | Regular marijuana use (monthly for ≥1 year). |
| **AgeRegMarij** | Age started regular marijuana use. |
| **HardDrugs** | Ever used cocaine, heroin, meth, etc. |
| **SexEver** | Ever had vaginal, oral, or anal sex. |
| **SexAge** | Age at first sexual intercourse. |
| **SexNumPartnLife** | Number of lifetime sexual partners. |
| **SexNumPartYear** | Number of partners in past 12 months. |
| **SameSex** | Ever had same-sex partner (Yes/No). |
| **SexOrientation** | Self-reported sexual orientation. |
| **WTINT2YR** | Interview sample weight. |
| **WTMEC2YR** | MEC exam sample weight. |
| **SDMVPSU** | Primary sampling unit. |
| **SDMVSTRA** | Sampling strata. |
